authorization: User requested existing-replay diagnosis and a plan directly executable by Sol. This turn delivers the design. When user forwards the accompanying execute instruction, Sol proceeds through finite R0-R9 without another start confirmation.
question: Does replacing 25% of the M79 training mixture with two neglected opponents recover anchor performance without sacrificing broad strength?
hypothesis: A distribution shift in early/middle resource planning is repairable by opponent coverage. Reserve penalty is not justified by existing replay evidence.
scope: One paired training seed, two arms: a finite method-screening pilot. No robust multi-seed algorithm claim. Same budget A/B makes the mixture intervention testable within this seed.

heuristic.label: Heuristic v0.3.1
heuristic.identity_policy: Bind exact engine SHA and heuristic descriptor from M79 frozen evaluation, plus golden player-observation action parity before launch. A newer same-named heuristic is not interchangeable.

training.initialization: fresh AdamW optimizer and fresh RNG, exact same parent weights for both arms; not M79 full-state resume
training.schedule: seed=81001000+128*cycle_index+block; opponent=period[block%16]; dispatch each physical seat once. 75% of A/B slots have identical opponent+seed+seat; replacement slots retain seed/seat with declared changed opponent.
training.final_candidate: B c20 fixed before all independent outcomes; A c20 always reported as control. No best-checkpoint, best-arm or best-seed selection.
training.truncation_policy: retain prefix/cost, no refill; ninth scientific truncation ends that arm as failed. Other completed valid arms and report proceed.
training.development_policy: No intermediate match sweep: candidate is fixed c20. Track numerical diagnostics and audit exports; all formal comparison uses the frozen new final grid.

evaluation.old_m79_data_role: used for diagnosis/hypothesis only; never counted as independent M81 confirmation
evaluation.shared_baseline: Evaluate M75 once on new cohort; shared exact rows for both A/base and B/base comparisons.
evaluation.missing_policy: No seed substitution or outcome imputation. Missing terminal/seat blocks the affected endpoint; report complete endpoints. Ninth scientific truncation stops new eval dispatch, preserving all evidence.
evaluation.coverage_note: Heuristic and old Balance become training opponents in B. Their new-seed tests measure in-opponent retention, not unseen-opponent generalization.

statistics.metric: half score=(W+0.5D)/N; pure win rate separate
statistics.unit: first average both seats within each environment seed; same seed blocks resampled jointly across base/A/B
statistics.pool_rule: Target pair equal weight; original six-opponent pool equal weight; separate eight-opponent diagnostic pool equal weight. Independently resample each opponent seed block within a replicate.

method_screen.pass_rule: All four endpoints complete and pass. A single-seed pilot finding only; report each target separately even if mean passes.

mainline_candidate.pass_rule: Every declared B gate complete and pass. Method-screen status is reported separately. Recommendation only, no release/default/deployment.

statistics.power: Fixed practical screening grid, no claim of 80% power for +2pp or 3pp noninferiority. A wide CI means inconclusive; no automatic extra samples.
statistics.training_seed_uncertainty: one paired seed; game-level CI does not estimate recipe robustness across training seeds

style.comparison: A and B versus M75 on exact shared six-opponent cohort; also A versus B
metrics: early token choices and first divergence
nobles from actual ownership, not choose_noble action count
style.route: undetermined/mixed/provisional permitted; no confirmed style or new version identity

resources.wall_policy: No date/time or elapsed-wall round kill. Preserve per-game hang detection and measured cumulative CPU/storage/attempt bounds. Old M79 absolute_stop, deadline fields and coordinator max_run_seconds must not silently survive in the new runtime.
resources.placement: Prefer DSW=A, DSW2=B in isolated roots; after train+audit either node claims remaining evaluation shards through one commit/lease authority.
resources.single_node_fallback: If only DSW reachable, run A then B automatically. Audit and archive completed A raw history with remote full-member SHA verification before reclaiming only M81-owned duplicate raw files as needed. Retain weights, full final optimizer/RNG state, manifests, reports, source and restore instructions. Never delete M79 history or wait for DSW2 as prerequisite.
resources.capacity: Derive concurrency from actual cpuset+CPU quota+memory+free disk; combined reservations fit all active writers. Reuse M79 measured storage/CPU as estimates, verify actual growth every cycle.
resources.cost_estimate: Historical M79 training used 54654 CPU seconds including retained history; two comparable arms roughly 109308 CPU seconds before new repairs/evaluation. Hardware and scheduling overhead determine elapsed time.
resources.eta: Planning range: two qualified 4-core nodes 6-10h, one such node serial 12-20h including engineering/audit/eval/report; not a guarantee or deadline. Replace after first 256 committed games with segment clocks and remaining workload.

recovery.rules: Verify node/PID/create_time/execution/source/weights/full optimizer+RNG+cursor; reconcile orphans; committed games and logical updates consumed once; cumulative CPU and failure history retained. Infrastructure repairs within this policy proceed without owner start confirmation.
recovery.stop: Completed finite workload, scientific invalidity, resource/attempt bound exhaustion, or user stop. Engineering/report failures get isolated source revision and bounded recovery; never rerun matches just to repair reports.
recovery.persistent: Install and verify process-independent stage/resume controller before first research game; session ending does not stop authorized progress. It terminates after R9.

observation.owner: Luna subagent, not a second Sol
notify_only: concrete action only the owner can perform
observation.handling: Local controller detects exits/hangs promptly; Luna is low-frequency independent review and recovery, not the only scheduler. Routine repairs proceed within bounds. Required owner intervention must state exact action; no hourly status spam.
observation.automatic_repair_scope: Recover unchanged scientific work, transfer/report adapters and identity-preserving evidence repairs; never change mixture/seeds/checkpoint/gates/CPU caps.
observation.final: Cancel or pause only this round monitor when delivered. Do not resurrect paused M79 reminders.

implementation.source_policy: Do not run M79 entrypoints unchanged or edit frozen deployed source. New isolated M81 source revision bound before first job. Resolve machine paths/hashes autonomously.
implementation.runtime_parity: Both arms use identical qualified numerical environment. Architecture/hyperparameters copied exactly from frozen M79 numeric blueprint; zero-new-game saved-fixture/optimizer/export/resume checks.

execution_contract: Forwarded Sol instruction authorizes engineering→zero-game preflight→two-arm training→audit→frozen independent eval→profiles→report→R9. Do not stop at plan acknowledgement, preflight, c20 export, ALL failure, a missing second node, or an unresolved style label.
